policy_text: Whatever Everyday Checking (checking, Everyday tier): no fee with qualifying direct deposit ≥ $750 monthly OR daily balance ≥ $1500; otherwise $6. Illustrative APY 0.00% when applicable. Rewards: none. Eligibility: debit standard.

Whatever Plus Checking (checking, Plus tier): waive with monthly direct deposit ≥ $2000 OR combined eligible balance ≥ $10000. Illustrative APY 0.00% when applicable. Rewards: 1% eligible debit cashback up to $8/month, demo only. Eligibility: debit plus.

Whatever Premier Checking (checking, Premier tier): waive with combined eligible balance ≥ $25000. Illustrative APY 0.05% when applicable. Rewards: 1.5% eligible debit rewards capped at $15/month, demo only. Eligibility: debit premier.
Whatever Starter Savings (savings, Starter tier): no monthly maintenance fee. Illustrative APY 2.00% when applicable. Rewards: variable APY, no balance tiers. Eligibility: none.

Whatever High-Five Savings (savings, High-Five tier): no monthly fee. Illustrative APY 3.20% when applicable. Rewards: variable APY applies to balances below $10000; 3.50% on $10000+. Eligibility: none.

Whatever Premier Savings (savings, Premier tier): no monthly fee; Premier Checking relationship eligibility. Illustrative APY 3.65% when applicable. Rewards: variable APY, relationship conditions apply. Eligibility: none.

Whatever Debit (debit_card, Standard tier): no annual card fee; out-of-network ATM charges may apply. Illustrative APY 0.00% when applicable. Rewards: no rewards. Eligibility: linked eligible checking.

Whatever Debit Plus (debit_card, Plus tier): no annual card fee. Illustrative APY 0.00% when applicable. Rewards: 1% on eligible debit purchases, capped at $8/month. Eligibility: linked Plus Checking.
Whatever Premier Debit (debit_card, Premier tier): no annual card fee. Illustrative APY 0.00% when applicable. Rewards: 1.5% eligible debit, capped $15/month. Eligibility: linked Premier Checking.

Whatever Cash-ish Card (credit_card, Cash-ish tier): $0 annual fee; APR varies by applicant and terms. Illustrative APY 0.00% when applicable. Rewards: 1.5% eligible purchases, sample reward terms only. Eligibility: application outside servicing MVP.

YOLO Miles Card (credit_card, Travel tier): $95 annual fee; APR varies by applicant and terms. Illustrative APY 0.00% when applicable. Rewards: 2 points per $1 eligible travel; 1 point per $1 elsewhere. Eligibility: application outside servicing MVP.

All APYs are synthetic variable illustration values as of 2026-10-01; a guest may receive rates only after selecting a product and verifying the current approved rate snapshot. If stale or missing, abstain and provide source date.

Preserve potential unauthorized debit report with original statement and receipt event. Do not delay preserving reports because account authentication is pending. Legal notice status is authoritative backend-controlled; no auto-dispute adjudication.

Guest mode exposes only approved public policy. Customer records, balances, account transactions, and cases require trusted session and per-resource authorization. Never ask for PIN, CVV, password, OTP in chat.
Restricted requests enter secure sign-in, then action-scoped authorization. Step-up required only when trusted risk policy indicates; chat text cannot assert verification.
Offer human service route with truthful pending/confirmed/failed state; do not invent wait times or queue confirmation.
Case created only after backend commit and case ID. Unknown submission result must reconcile with same idempotency key; never auto-create duplicate.
Compare monthly service fee and eligibility by exact product tier; do not apply waiver conditions across checking tiers. Fees for personal historical transactions require sign-in.
Never retrieve Chase, Capital One, or any real bank policy when answering Bank of Whatever product-specific terms. Fail closed on bank mismatch.
